main_text.p: Epit. Yafei ] Historiam scripsit [illegible, ~6 letters] Abdollah Ebn Asaad AlYafer, ab initio aerae Hejrae usque ad annum 750. quam in compendium redegit [illegible, ~8 letters] AlHofain Ebn Ab-dor Rahman quidam.343.
Aus Ebn Hajar Poeta ] [illegible, ~5 letters] Aus Ebn Hajar Abu Shoraibi. Mezhar.
Hofainus Helajius ] est is, [illegible, ~9 letters] abu Mogith AlHofain Ebn Mansfur AlHallaj. Interfectus est anno H. 309. Ebn Chalec. AbulFed. &c.338.

Abu Yazid AlBeftamienfis ] [illegible, ~6 letters] Abu Yazid Taiphur Ebn Isa AlBastami. Obiit anno H.261. dictum ab eo fertur, [illegible, ~10 letters] [illegible, ~12 letters] [illegible, ~14 letters] [illegible, ~12 letters]268.Si conspexeritis virum miraculorum potentiâ praeditum, adeo ut vel in aërem sublimis tollatur, ne tamen ab eo decipiamini donec perspectum vobis sit quomodo se habeat respectu mandati & interdicti, & custodiæ finium [rebus lege praescriptorum] & observantia legis.Ib.Ebn Chalec.
main_text.head: Addenda.
main_text.p: Idolis, pag. 101. &c. enumeratis accenfenda etiam [illegible, ~4 letters] Iebar Hawazenenfium idolum & [illegible, ~3 letters] Al Auf alibi cultum. [illegible, ~3 letters] apud posteros Rabia idolatriæ. [illegible, ~5 letters] AlDaizan autem cujus p. 338 in margine mentionem fecimus, idem forsan erat cum Saturno. conjecturæ ansam præbet quod apud Ebn Chalecca-num legitur in vita AlBattanii, regem scil. quendam [illegible, ~5 letters]

page.notes: Arabic script lines are illegible in this scan and are marked with approximate letter counts rather than guessed. Marginal notes "Ib." and "Ebn Chalec." are placed beside the Si conspexeritis passage. "Hejrae", "AlYafer" and "Rabia idolatriæ" (partly printed in small type) are uncertain in their exact spelling. "Addenda." is treated as a level 2 part heading.
